purpose: Produce a denylist of hashes of canonical E1 neighborhood identities for future P-v02 collision checking, without exposing raw E1 identities to the P panel generator.

source.canonical_identity_semantics: The sealed matched-panel manifest producer writes neighborhood_id from the canonical anchor/neighborhood identity. No world/root identity field is present in this panel manifest; this denylist therefore covers canonical E1 neighborhood IDs only.

extraction.all_other_manifest_values: Skipped as opaque JSON bytes; not decoded, retained, emitted, or used.

identity_hash.canonicalization: Decode the one JSON string field as UTF-8; use its exact decoded scalar value with no trimming, case folding, or Unicode normalization; encode that value as strict UTF-8.

output.format: sorted unique JSONL; each row contains only identity_sha256
output.p_collision_rule: For each P-v02 canonical neighborhood identity, compute the same domain-separated SHA-256 and test membership in this hash set. Report only P-side collision identities/counts; do not emit any E1 metadata.

forbidden_inputs_and_operations: E1 candidate joins or candidate feature catalogs
E1 raw targets or target distributions
E1 predictions, metrics, treatment outcomes, geometry diagnostics, or head outputs
reading any P-v01 failed-attempt panel content
panel generation, LFM loading, feature extraction, training, or evaluation
